To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the following OLM related factors are associated with higher project success: (1) the OLMs reputation, (2) the reputation of the OLMs platform, (3) the OLM's size, (4) the OLM s experience in the project, and (5) the OLM' s experience in the industry.

(1) the performance of a project in the online labor market is influenced by the pre contract characteristics of the online labor market platform; (2) the performance of the project is influenced by the characteristics of the project itself; (3) the performance of projects is also influenced by the characteristics related to the relationship between the employer and the worker; and, (4) these three sets of characteristics interact to influence project success.

(i) project success is higher when the project description is more detailed and when the client is more experienced, (ii) project success is lower when the project duration is longer and when the client's budget is larger, and (iii) project success is not significantly influenced by the number of bidders, the project price, or the client's rating.

the OLM related factors that we investigate in this paper are indeed significant in the context of online labor markets.
the OLM related factors that are relevant for performance in OLM projects are: (1) the number of completed projects, (2) the number of projects with a rating, and (3) the number of ratings.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OLMs are a new and important type of organization that can serve as an alternative to traditional organizations.
we show that project success in OLMs is not only driven by the quality of the agent's profile but also by the platform's design.
the success of a project on an OLM is a function of both pre- and post- contract OLM related factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OLMs are a promising way to organize work, especially in the context of project-based tasks and that they offer the potential to overcome some of the problems of traditional employment relationships.
project performance can be significantly improved by the use of OLM related factors.
